body.heading: About this sheet
paragraphs: Free SparkKindly Kids dot-to-dot printable: Connect the Dots 15.
Numbered dots to join in order until a picture appears — then color it in and make it yours.

body.heading: How to use it
paragraphs: Print the sheet, find number 1, and draw a straight line to 2, then 3, all the way to the end. Say each number out loud as you land on it.

takeaway: Dot-to-dot makes number order feel like a treasure hunt — the picture is the prize.
materials: Crayons or markers for the finished picture
supervision: Count along for the first few numbers, then let them call the numbers and drive the pencil.
safetyNotes: Print at 100% size (not "fit to page") so the sheet keeps its true size and the pictures stay the size they were drawn.
screenFreeExtension: Count the dots backwards from the biggest number to 1 — then count real stairs or steps the same way.
